scope: Local synthetic verification; final acceptance from the frozen staged source only.

attempts.result: Five failures exposed production transport keys shorter than the channel minimum for single-digit merchant and delivery IDs. One test incorrectly threw an HTTP response instead of returning the provider HTTP 400 response. Fixed short production keys without changing previously valid keys; corrected the response fixture.
All generation, reviewed delivery, recovery, worker bootstrap and key contract cases passed. Additional quota contention, final expiry and missing-reservation cases followed.
All then-current usage cases passed on a fresh local database beginning with single-digit identities.

Stopped only the owned test runner tree after source review identified that failed/rejected transport settlement also needed the final recovery lease fence. Added two behavioral cases; superseded partial results are excluded. All suites restart from a new frozen snapshot and clean disposable database.
Final usage cases, including rollback and later recovery for leases expiring during failed/rejected transport settlement, passed. The 272 unselected baseline cases are included in the final full run.
